evals.prompt: The NVDA daily plan says prior-day high 202.4 but TradingView shows 199.8 for 2026-10-27. Find out if it's our data, our code, or the provider.
evals.expected_output: Runs check_bars on the plan's input bars, reports the source/feed/adjustment, identifies whether the bar breaks a row rule (DATA_ERROR), whether IEX vs SIP scope explains a high inside/outside the consolidated range (expected, not an error), or whether the level code read the wrong bar (COMPUTE_ERROR). Names the bar id.
assertions: classifies into one of the four codes
does not call an IEX/SIP difference an error by itself

evals.prompt: Alpaca returned 20 daily bars for a new listing; the plan shows EMA50 trend DOWN. Is that right?
evals.expected_output: INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY for EMA50 (has 20, needs 50); the daily frame may report EMA20-based trend only if 22 bars exist, otherwise INSUFFICIENT; the DOWN label must not be published.

evals.prompt: Ticker XYZ shows a -50% gap on 2026-10-20 in our unadjusted intraday bars and nothing in the daily bars.
evals.expected_output: Flags SPLIT_SUSPECT on the unadjusted series (ratio near 2:1), checks the adjustment mode of each series, refuses to mix adjusted daily with unadjusted intraday in one level.
assertions: flags split suspect rather than a crash
